answer: Triage every agent at entry like an ED sorting a harbor of casualties: require proof-of-personhood credentials plus staked bonds, so sybils must fund each fake identity and wait out verification. Rank agents by urgency-weighted reputation, like an orchard graded by yield, capping low-trust newcomers to scarce task slots until costly audits clear them. This raises attacker cost per identity, though a mesa of colluding verified accounts still erodes the signal, so periodic re-attestation limits that.
